testCases.title: Successful authentication stores JWT and navigates to home page
testCases.objective: Verify that upon successful authentication, the returned JWT token is stored in localStorage and the user is navigated to the home page.

preconditions.description: User has valid credentials and is on the login page.

inputs.name: credentials
inputs.description: A valid username and password pair.

steps.action: Enter valid username and password into the login form.
Observe client storage for the JWT token and observe navigation.

expectedResults.description: JWT token is stored in client storage (localStorage).
The user is navigated to the home page.

reasons: Can be automated with browser automation tools to verify localStorage and navigation.

testCases.title: Authentication failure displays 401 Unauthorized error message
testCases.objective: Verify that when authentication fails, the system displays a 401 Unauthorized error message to the user.

steps.action: Enter invalid credentials into the login form.

expectedResults.description: A 401 Unauthorized error message is displayed to the user.

reasons: Can be automated with browser automation tools to assert error message presence.

testCases.title: Authentication request sent to Authentication API endpoint
testCases.objective: Verify that the system sends an authentication request to the Authentication API (POST /smartsales-api-v2/auth/verifyUser/v1) with the user's credentials.

preconditions.description: User is on the login page with credentials ready.

inputs.name: credentials
inputs.description: A valid username and password pair.

steps.action: Capture the network request sent to the authentication API.

expectedResults.description: The request body contains the user's credentials.

reasons: Can be automated with API testing or network interception.

testCases.title: Login input validation displays error for invalid data
testCases.objective: Verify that the system validates login form input data and displays an error message when the input is invalid.

preconditions.description: User is on the login page.

inputs.name: loginFormData
inputs.description: Invalid login form data (e.g., missing username or password, malformed email).

steps.action: Enter invalid data into the login form fields.

expectedResults.description: The system validates the input data.
An error message is displayed to the user.

reasons: Can be automated with UI test frameworks to check validation messages.

testCases.title: Column allows NULL values
testCases.objective: Verify that the database column associated with rule-0000 accepts NULL values.

preconditions.description: The database table and column exist.

steps.action: Insert a record with a NULL value for the specified column.

expectedResults.description: The insert or update operation with NULL value succeeds.

reasons: Can be automated with SQL scripts to test NULL acceptance.

dataNeeds.description: JWT token returned by the authentication API.
User credentials to be sent in the authentication request.
A NULL value for the database column associated with rule-0000.
